steps: Owner creates source, saves secrets, creates trigger (owner message revision, activated_at baseline for non-poll)
event-worker main loop (1s) claims poll sources (<=4 jobs, includes http) and socket sources (<=10) with 360s fenced leases
poll: credentials (connection refresh under row lock + source secrets), verify identity on initializing, http sources only heartbeat, fetch one page outside DB transaction
Drive: verify newly observed Google Docs against successful drive.create receipts with a read-only export
commit_page under lease: normalize items, ingest each, upsert resource versions, store cursor/progress atomically, schedule next poll, set activated_at on first complete baseline
socket: apps.connections.open, pinned wss connect, hello app_id, heartbeat extends lease; each envelope recorded via receive then acked after commit
webhook: POST /hooks/{provider}/{id} reads <=1 MiB in 10s, locks source, verifies signature with current/previous secret, handles Slack url_verification, receive(); response sent after commit
receive dedupes by delivery key/body hash, applies daily cap, normalizes (unsupported/recording_failed recorded), calls ingest and stores encrypted body only if recorded
ingest: event_key dedupe, availability check, own-write suppression, per active trigger match/baseline/access, insert event (encrypted if retained), delivery, pending/coalesced runs, matches

advance -> admit_pending: rotate, expire, lock conversation without waiting, overlap and per-bot queue checks, validate, self-event recheck (ignored), daily cap, wait for unsettled connector ops, then system thread + create_saved_task(origin=event) -> admitted
Worker claim_new: triggers.claim_locks then start_allowed with nonblocking share locks; cancels if revised/paused/expired/invalid

Failures classify source status, back off and pause triggers when access/resync/inspection needed; maintenance expires payloads/secrets and pauses unavailable destinations; heartbeat file for compose healthcheck

flow:g.title: Notification fan-out > web push > service worker
flow:g.summary: Domain row changes mark attention dirty via DB triggers; the notification-worker projects attention items and enqueues per-browser deliveries; a separate pump claims and sends generic VAPID Web Push through the pinned transport; the service worker shows a generic notification and routes clicks to the current attention resolution.
steps: Browser registration: Notifications.tsx registers /sw.js, PushManager.subscribe, POST /api/v1/notifications/subscriptions; server validates keys/endpoint, encrypts, sets device cookie and generation
AFTER INSERT/UPDATE triggers on tasks, approvals, connector_operations, routine_definitions, event_sources, connections, etc. call attention_dirty
notification-worker project pump: attention.drain (try-lock 887832154) projects subjects; reconcile updates heartbeat_at; maintenance expires subscriptions/deliveries; touch heartbeat file
materialize of a new item version calls notifications.enqueue

enqueue: requires push_enabled, category, configured VAPID, unread active item; quiet deferral, category delays, 24h freshness; per matching subscription insert delivery or overflow summary (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING)

delivery pump: claim under try-lock scans 30 due deliveries; suppresses irrelevant (eligible re-projects), reschedules quiet, folds batches into one summary (covered), defers bursts >=3/min, leases one as dispatching with TTL
deliver: live recheck, pywebpush with generic payload, Topic hash, VAPID claims, via PinnedSession -> connector_http.request
Record accepted/failed/expired/pending with backoff (lease-token fenced); 404/410 retire subscription, 401/403 server_key_error, accept updates subscription status
Push service wakes the browser service worker: push handler shows generic "Hermbot" notification with sanitized tag and validated target
notificationclick focuses/navigates a same-origin window to /?attention=<id>; App reads the param and resolves GET /api/v1/attention/{id} to current state
Owner preference save suppresses pending deliveries and re-enqueues current items; logout disables this browser subscription

flow:f.title: Manager lifecycle proposal > owner approval > supervisor outbox > provisioning > manager resumes
flow:f.summary: A manager bot holding a grant proposes create/configure/start/stop; the owner approves the exact snapshot; the decision enqueues a bot_operation that the worker drives through the supervisor; the manager task resumes with a continuation once provisioning settles.
steps: Owner issues authority: standing grant (POST /api/v1/grants) or a task grant created with the task.
Manager model calls hermbot_propose; plugin forwards to /internal/tools with framework tool_call_id as receipt.

lifecycle.prepare checks grant authority/targets/creation budget, assigns server id for create, validates full config within grant resource limits, rejects busy targets without interrupt and uncertain work, freezes provider revision and affected tasks.
lifecycle.propose inserts approvals(kind lifecycle, payload hash, expiry) and lifecycle_proposals(pending); task -> waiting_approval; manager told to end turn.
Optionally owner edits: PUT /api/v1/proposals/{id} supersedes old proposal, stales approval, re-proposes.
Owner approves via POST /api/v1/approvals/{id} with expected_payload_hash; expiry/task-stopped/grant rechecked.

lifecycle.decide: deny -> proposal denied + resume. Approve -> recheck authority and provider revision; create: group <=6, register bot, grant created_bots+1 and target appended, participant added; else bot NOWAIT lock, expected revision, identical affected tasks, reserve_lifecycle, apply config or desired_state.
registry.enqueue(key proposal:<id>, proposal_id) creates bot_operations(queued) snapshot; proposal -> queued with operation_id; bots.status provisioning.
Worker loop claims op (120 s lease), drive waits for idle bot, re-checks the manager task and grant before dispatch (else cancels op, bot error, proposal cancelled), marks op and proposal applying.
drive decrypts provider key, bot token, runtime key and POSTs RuntimeSpec to supervisor /operations/{action} with SUPERVISOR_TOKEN.
Supervisor: per-bot lock, receipt replay or execute ensure: volumes/network, connect api/worker, create hardened hermbot-bot-<id>, start, wait healthy; write fsynced receipt.

Success: op completed, bot status active (or archived/deleted), applied_revision set, readiness cleared; proposal completed; lifecycle.resume appends continuation (bot id/action/state, use hermbot_teammates) and requeues the manager task.
Failure: op failed, bot error, proposal failed, manager resumed with failure text; transport loss leaves op applying for re-drive.
Probe refreshes readiness (networks reconcile + capabilities); new bot becomes dispatchable; resumed manager attempt dispatched by claim_new.

flow:i.title: Login, session and owner authentication
flow:i.summary: Owner pastes OWNER_TOKEN once; the API mints an opaque HttpOnly session cookie whose hash is stored; every owner request/WebSocket is verified against the bearer or the cookie hash; logout and session revocation are explicit.
steps: Compose requires OWNER_TOKEN; api lifespan refuses any service secret shorter than 32 chars.
UI POSTs /api/v1/session with Authorization Bearer token.
auth.verify compares bearer with compare_digest.
auth.login creates token_urlsafe(32), stores sha256 in owner_sessions with 1-day expiry and sets hermbot_session cookie HttpOnly SameSite=Strict (Secure if https).
Later requests: owner dependency verifies cookie hash not revoked/expired; middleware rejects cross-origin non-GET.
WebSocket computer stream: Origin==Host, verify, re-verify every 5 s.
Owner can list and revoke sessions by hash.
Logout revokes current session, signs out push device, deletes cookies.
Bots authenticate separately with HERMBOT_BOT_TOKEN hash lookup.

flow:j.title: Bot create / clone / delete provisioning path
flow:j.summary: Owner lifecycle requests become bot_operations snapshots driven by the worker through the supervisor; clone uses a helper container; delete removes runtime and private volumes but keeps history.
steps: Create: POST /api/v1/bots (Idempotency-Key) -> validate_config -> register (lock, max_bots, id, credentials, DM) -> enqueue 'create'.
Clone: POST /bots/{id}/clone -> roster lock, source revision check, reserve source, register target, enqueue 'clone' with source_bot_id, source_revision, source_was_running, copy_options.
Worker drives op; skips while target or clone source has active attempts.

Supervisor ensure(clone=True): clone_state validates options/ownership, stops source, runs hermbot-clone-<op> (root, no network, source ro, target rw) executing copy_state.py, waits, restarts source if it was running; then creates runtime; cleanup_clone removes helper.
copy_state copies memory/skills/workspace and history via SQLite backup; skips symlinks and credential/config names; browser volume never copied.
Runtime container start triggers hermes_bootstrap and health checks on 8642/8643.
Delete: POST /bots/{id}/delete with exact-name confirmation -> desired stopped, enqueue delete, status deleting (bot token rejected).
Supervisor delete removes container, clone helpers, owned volumes and dynamic network (disconnecting api/worker).
Completion: status deleted, credentials nulled, participants removed; conversations remain as Past teammates.

flow:k.title: Attachment upload > MinIO > install into bot workspace
flow:k.summary: Owner uploads base64 file to a conversation; bytes stored in MinIO with sha256; before each native run the worker reads (verifying checksum) and the supervisor installs them into /workspace/attachments/<id>/<name> via root exec staging and write_attachment.py.
steps: UI POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/attachments with Idempotency-Key.
Validate ASCII plain name, MIME allowlist, strict base64, 1 B..10 MB; compute sha256.
put_object to bucket hermbot key attachments/<conv>/<id> with sha metadata; insert attachments row (idempotent receipt).
Owner message/task carries attachment_ids (tasks.attachment_ids).
Worker drive (before native start, no human control) calls provisioning.copy_attachments: attachments + artifacts granted to the task.
ArtifactStore.read_bytes verifies size and sha256; POST supervisor /attachments with base64.

Supervisor validates filename, base64, size and checksum, finds runtime, then under the per-bot lock: STAGING_INIT, 60 000-byte STAGING_WRITE chunks, exec write_attachment.py, all as root via docker exec.
write_attachment.install re-validates, walks /workspace with O_NOFOLLOW dir fds, writes temp O_EXCL, fsync, chown hermes, atomic replace; staging unlinked.
Bot reads /workspace/attachments/<id>/<name>; owner can download via GET /api/v1/attachments/{id}.

flow:l.title: Stack startup sequence
flow:l.summary: Compose orders postgres (healthy) and storage (started) before api; api initializes DB under an advisory lock, runs schema+migrations, seeds core bots, bootstraps credentials and creates the bucket; worker waits for api health and the runtime image build, then bootstraps 'ensure' operations that make the supervisor create runtime containers, whose bootstrap starts the adapter and Hermes gateway.
steps: runtime-image service builds hermbot-hermes:phase4 and exits 0 (network none).
postgres healthy via pg_isready; storage started (no healthcheck); supervisor starts independently (no depends_on).
api starts after postgres healthy and storage started.

api lifespan: secret length check; db.initialize: open pool, advisory xact lock 887832101, run schema.sql then sorted migrations, seed Scout/Quill/Sage with runtime_url http://hermes-<id>:8642 and DMs, registry.bootstrap (env provider import, per-bot credentials).
ArtifactStore.initialize creates bucket 'hermbot' if missing.
api healthcheck /health runs SELECT 1.
worker (after api healthy and runtime-image completed) and event/notification workers (after api healthy) also run db.initialize serialized by the advisory lock.

Worker loop: queue_initial enqueues 'ensure' for active bots with applied_revision < revision (fresh seeds have 1 > 0); drive -> supervisor creates hermbot-bot-<id> (migrating any legacy compose container found by find_runtime).
Runtime bootstrap: install read-only plugin, drop to hermes, clean Chromium markers, write config.yaml/SOUL.md, validate skills, spawn adapter 8643, exec Hermes gateway 8642.
Supervisor waits for container health; worker probe stores readiness; dispatch enabled for compatible bots. Restart: runtimes restart unless-stopped; worker reconciles networks.

flow:a.title: Owner message -> intake -> work item -> dispatch -> native run -> events -> outcome/acceptance -> UI
flow:a.summary: An owner chat message (intent auto) becomes a queued carrier task; the worker's intake loop interprets it with the bot's model provider and applies work item/requirement changes; claim_new admits the task into an attempt; drive starts a Hermes run; the Hermbot plugin calls /internal/context and /internal/tools during the run; runtime events are streamed into events; settle applies finish claims to outcomes (acceptance) and posts the result message; SSE and /state polling update the UI and attention.
steps: UI composer posts POST /api/v1/messages with a client Idempotency-Key and MessageRequest payload (intent defaults to 'auto').
Middleware rejects cross-origin non-GET; owner dependency verifies session cookie/bearer.
submit_message -> submit validates the key and calls service.create_task with orchestration_version=2, coordination_version=1, context chat/group.

create_task: advisory xact lock on request_key, fingerprint compare (replay returns existing row), validations (conversation not archived FOR SHARE, bot active/running, participant, files, skills, thread root, mentions, grants).

INSERT tasks status 'queued'; set budget/attachments; insert owner user message source_id request:{task}; set orchestration_version=2, owner_message_id, intake_status 'pending'; message_intent stays 'auto'; event task.queued. DB trigger attention_tasks marks the task dirty.
Response 202 with task row; UI also receives events via SSE.
Worker process (svc:worker) main loop runs work_intake.run as a background asyncio task.

advance_one claims the oldest queued auto task with intake pending/interpreting per conversation FIFO (FOR UPDATE OF t SKIP LOCKED), sets interpreting + attempts+1 + 60s lease, builds evidence and reads the bot's provider.

interpret() POSTs {provider.base_url}/chat/completions (Bearer decrypted provider key) with INSTRUCTION + evidence, optional read_context tool; validates Interpretation and delivery alignment; up to 4 rounds/45s.
apply() in a new transaction: locked_task, skip if applied/stopped, message hash + observed revision checks, forced target, combined operations, derived tasks for extra operations.
Assignment: work_items.route(intake=True) -> new_item inserts work_items, sets task work_item_id/message_intent 'assignment', links work_item_messages, event work.created.

work_controller.apply registers requirements (work_outcomes, task_outcomes, owner_task_id), bumps revision, records work_authorizations from quoted requested_effects, writes work_changes, emits revise commands to other active tasks, event work.revised.
Intake marks intake_status 'applied' (+intake_result), optional clarification continuation, event message.interpreted.
Worker main loop each second: work_controller.advance (reconcile commands), advance_waiters, claim_existing, then claim_new.

claim_new takes global advisory lock 887832103, schedules inboxes, computes capacity, checks bot eligibility and picks the oldest queued task no longer 'auto'; acquires work item/root/bot locks with SKIP LOCKED; preflight (grant, deadline, budget, connector ops).
Session lookup/creation (sessions or thread_sessions), prompt assembly (input, thread, skills, handoff, attachments, granted files, pending controls), MANAGED_POLICY + COORDINATION_POLICY.
INSERT attempts 'dispatching' (idempotency_key hermbot:{attempt}, 12s lease, worker_id); controls/work_commands 'included'; task 'running'; event task.started (UI clears partial text).
drive(): copy attachments into bot workspace, ensure native session (GET/POST /api/sessions), POST /v1/runs with Idempotency-Key; store runtime_run_id and status running; budget accounting.

Inside the bot, the Hermbot plugin pre_llm_call hook POSTs /internal/context; app.context resolves the admitted task through active_task (attempt by bot+session) and returns message_routing (work, outcomes, owner instructions, authorization), capabilities, connector policy, teammate inbox.
llm_request middleware re-fetches context to cache the work revision, injects inbox, acknowledges inbox and records tool visibility.

Each tool call passes execution_boundary -> admitted_execution: /internal/context with tool_call_id (event tool.admitted), work revision check, routing/capability gating; hermbot_* tools POST /internal/tools with receipt_id=tool_call_id and expected_work_revision.

app.tools validates args (ARGUMENT_MODELS) and requires expected_work_revision; service.tool_action dedupes via tool_receipts, checks revision/waiting_input/routing/require_work, executes the operation (e.g. publish -> artifacts + outcome evidence; finish -> pending_result/pending_outcomes), stores receipt, event tool.receipt.

Concurrently collect_events streams GET /v1/runs/{id}/events; record_event inserts each event (source_id runtime:{attempt}:{seq}, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), marks stream complete on run.* terminal events, creates runtime approvals.
drive polls GET /v1/runs/{id}; while running it delivers decisions/controls and queues monitor assessments; on terminal status calls settle and cancels the stream task.
settle(): lock task+attempt, account time, set attempt status/terminal, reconcile_requests, compute task state (completed / waiting_* / failed / recovery requeue).

outcomes.settle re-validates finish claims in a savepoint and records each: accountable owner path -> result_acceptance.record inserts result_acceptances, accepts reviewed contributions, marks outcome fulfilled, event result.accepted.
Completed with output: grant child artifacts to parent, insert assistant message runtime-result:{attempt}, event task.completed (or task.failed when empty / task.{state}).
SSE: GET /api/v1/events polls events id>cursor every 0.5s and yields 'update' frames; UI EventSource appends message.delta and debounces invalidation of state/chat/attention queries.
UI re-fetches /api/v1/state (work_items via list_items + outcomes.projection) and the conversation transcript; WorkItems renders card status/progress.
Notification worker drains attention_pending and materializes a work 'result' item once work is completed and fully settled (or a problem item); Attention panel polls /api/v1/attention.

flow:b.title: Teammate coordination: message / delegate / wait / finish / read_artifact
flow:b.summary: A running teammate (coordination v1) delegates contributions to peers, messages them via a durable inbox, waits explicitly for required results (releasing capacity), is resumed by coordination.advance, inspects contributed artifacts, and accepts the shared deliverable at settlement.
steps: Manager calls hermbot_teammates to discover peers and their effective capabilities.
hermbot_delegate -> /internal/tools -> tool_action resolves outcome_keys and calls service.delegate.
delegate validates bot/grant/depth/cycle/handoff budget/outcome ids/dependencies/files/skills.

Child task inserted queued/blocked with handoff brief and inherited work item/versions; outcomes.share binds task_outcomes; result_acceptance.assign inserts a pending contribution (or transfers deliverable); dependencies/artifact_access; root handoffs+1; event task.delegated; parent keeps running (v1).
hermbot_message -> coordination.send inserts teammate_messages pending (scoped recipient, validated reply_to); event teammate.message_sent.

If the recipient is running, its next /internal/context returns teammate_inbox; plugin llm_request injects it and POSTs /internal/inbox-delivered -> coordination.delivered marks delivered to that attempt.
If idle, claim_new's schedule_inboxes creates a peer_message discussion task for the recipient and links response_task_id; it then runs like any task and replies with hermbot_message reply_to.

Child runs (flow:a steps for dispatch), publishes artifacts and calls hermbot_finish with results; at settlement result_acceptance.record marks its contribution 'submitted' with submission payload (not fulfilment).
Manager calls hermbot_wait with task_ids/message_ids: coordination_waits inserted (cycle checks), task -> waiting_results; it ends its turn.
Manager's settle keeps it waiting_results (capacity released) while required contributions are unaccepted.
advance_waiters -> coordination.advance: when waits resolve or fail and the update signature changed, requeue the manager with a data-only continuation listing submissions/replies/failures.
Resumed manager inspects contributed files with hermbot_read_artifact (receipt recorded) and work_status.

Manager finishes with results(key, artifact_id, review, reviewed_task_ids); at its settlement validate() checks contributions submitted+completed, reviews listed, read_artifact receipts, review text; result_acceptances inserted, contributions accepted, outcome fulfilled.
Failed required contribution: advance wakes the manager; it may delegate with replaces_task_id (supersede, keep required) or reassign (manager grant).
Legacy v0: delegate sets parent waiting_children; advance_waiters releases blocked dependents and resumes the parent with all child results when children settle.

flow:h.title: Stop / retry / recovery after worker or container restart
flow:h.summary: Owner Stop cancels a task tree and the worker stops the native run; Redirect becomes a revision or control; Retry creates a new task after the old tree settles; Continue adds budget. After a worker crash another (or restarted) worker takes over expired attempt leases and reconnects to the same native run identity; ambiguous cases become uncertain instead of replaying.
steps: Stop: UI POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/stop -> service.cancel on the locked task.

cancel walks descendants (or occurrence tree); for each non-terminal task: attempts -> stopping, task -> cancelling (active attempt) / cancelled / stays uncertain; stop_kind/stop_reason; discards monitor controls; cancels pending approvals, questions, lifecycle/knowledge proposals, connector drafts; event task.stop_requested.
drive sees attempt 'stopping' and POSTs /v1/runs/{id}/stop; polling continues until terminal.
settle forces status 'cancelled' for cancelling tasks and uses the stored stop_reason as error; failed parents cancel descendants.
Redirect: POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/steer (owner_receipts idempotency) -> service.steer: v2 creates an auto-intake task with owner_work_target (revision path, flow:a), legacy inserts a controls row.

deliver_decisions sends one pending control via POST /v1/runs/{id}/steer (dispatching -> delivered); 409 returns it to pending for the next continuation; transport errors mark it uncertain; stale 'dispatching' from an old lease become uncertain.

Retry: POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/retry requires failed/interrupted/cancelled, not all required results fulfilled, no unknown connector outcomes, no active attempts in tree; creates replacement task (v2 via intake targeting the work item).

Continue after budget pause: POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/continue -> execution_policy.continue_work adds allowance and restores each paused task to queued/waiting_input/waiting_approval/blocked/waiting_results/waiting_children.
Retry interpretation: POST /api/v1/messages/{id}/retry-interpretation resets intake to pending.

Worker restart: new WORKER_ID; claim_existing re-leases attempts in dispatching/running/waiting_for_approval/stopping/external/reserved whose lease expired (12s) using FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED; uncertain attempts are excluded.

drive on a re-leased attempt: with runtime_run_id it skips start and polls the same run; without it, re-POSTs /v1/runs with the same Idempotency-Key (Hermes dedupes), unless the attempt is >23h old (mark_uncertain).
Event stream restarts; coverage flag event_stream_gap records that events may have been missed (prevents later automatic recovery).

Bot container restart: GET /v1/runs/{id} 404 for an accepted run -> attempt/task uncertain (no replay); other HTTP errors keep the receipt and retry next loop; runtime 'interrupted' status settles task interrupted (retryable by owner).

Automatic recovery: settle requeues a definitely failed retryable run (rate limit/provider/connection) when no tool started, coverage complete, grant/connector checks pass, budget left and recovery_failures < MAX_RECOVERIES (default 2); event execution.recovery_queued.

discrepancies.key: Unit module test_phase4_acceptance_evidence imports live-acc
discrepancies.text: Unit module test_phase4_acceptance_evidence imports live-acceptance modules (phase4_read_acceptance -> protocol_acceptance) whose import has side effects: os.environ["OWNER_TOKEN"] KeyError if unset and an httpx client is constructed at import. Pure verifier tests therefore cannot be collected without live-stack env.

discrepancies.text: Steer route without Idempotency-Key uses a random key, so client retries are not idempotent (a v2 Redirect creates a fresh intake task per retry).

discrepancies.text: Intake FIFO only considers pending/interpreting rows, so a failed earlier interpretation does not hold later messages; after a retry the earlier message is applied after later ones.
